label: Close change
gloss: the bar's own change, ((close − open) / open) × 100

label: Close location
gloss: where the bar closed within its own range, (close − low) / (high − low) — 0 at the low, 1 at the high; no value on a bar whose high equals its low

label: Close run
gloss: consecutive closes in one direction ending at this bar, signed: +n when the last n closes each closed above their prior close, −n below, 0 when the close equals the prior close; capped at ±20

gloss: 20-period Chaikin money flow — each bar's volume weighted by where it closed in its range (−1 at the low, +1 at the high, 0 on a flat bar), summed over the 20 bars ending at this bar and divided by their volume; no value when that volume is zero

period.description: The indicator’s length: the bars its window reads.

label: Convergence confidence
gloss: confidence in the convergence read — high when accEdgeZ is at least 1.96 and buyPres_trend is rising or falling; moderate when one of the two holds; low when neither; compared on the unrounded score; no value without accEdgeZ or buyPres_trend

label: Crowd accuracy
gloss: crowd accuracy on this coin (%), last 4 settled sessions

label: Crowd accuracy edge (z)
gloss: how far the crowd’s accuracy on this coin sits from a coin flip (50%), in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; last 4 settled sessions; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells

label: Crowd accuracy edge (z, live)
gloss: how far the crowd’s accuracy on this coin sits from a coin flip (50%), in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells; provisional while the sessions run, an unresolved cell counting as not correct

label: Crowd accuracy (live)
gloss: crowd accuracy on this coin (%), live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running

label: Crowd captain rate
gloss: share of grids picking this coin that captain it (%), last 4 settled sessions

label: Crowd captain excess (z)
gloss: how far the share of this coin’s cells that are captained sits from the rest of the field’s over the same window, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; last 4 settled sessions; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells, or when the rest of the field is empty or never or always captains

label: Crowd captain excess (z, live)
gloss: how far the share of this coin’s cells that are captained sits from the rest of the field’s over the same window, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells, or when the rest of the field is empty or never or always captains

label: Crowd captain rate (live)
gloss: share of grids picking this coin that captain it (%), live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running

label: Crowd pick rate
gloss: share of the field picking this coin (%), last 4 settled sessions

label: Crowd pick rate (live)
gloss: share of the field picking this coin (%), live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running

label: Crowd up-bias
gloss: share of this coin’s picks that are directional up (%), last 4 settled sessions

label: Crowd up-bias (live)
gloss: share of this coin’s picks that are directional up (%), live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running

label: Crowd up-share excess (z)
gloss: how far this coin’s up share sits from the rest of the field’s over the same window, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; last 4 settled sessions; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells, or when the rest of the field is empty or unanimous

label: Crowd up-share excess (z, live)
gloss: how far this coin’s up share sits from the rest of the field’s over the same window, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells, or when the rest of the field is empty or unanimous

label: Crowd lean (z)
gloss: how far this coin’s up share sits from 50%, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; last 4 settled sessions; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells

label: Crowd lean (z, live)
gloss: how far this coin’s up share sits from 50%, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells

label: Cumulative Volume Delta (UTC day)
gloss: TradingView's cumulative volume delta — each intrabar's volume signed by its close against its open, then against the previous intrabar's close, summed since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor; intrabars are 1m on minute and hour rungs and 5m on 1d

label: Order-flow CVD (UTC day)
gloss: order-flow cumulative volume delta — taker buy minus taker sell volume from the trade tape, accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor; it reads no value for the rest of the UTC day after a bar whose taker flow is unknown, never a partial sum

label: UTC weekday
gloss: the UTC weekday the bar opened on, as the index 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, 2 = Tuesday, 3 = Wednesday, 4 = Thursday, 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday — a fact of the bar's open time; a weekend is DAY_OF_WEEK outside 1 to 5
